2 كوّذ , inf. n. تَكْوِيذٌ, It (an إِزَار [or a wrapper for the lower part of the body and the thighs]) reached to the part called the كَاذَة (L, K) only. (L.) ―
-b2- He (a man in the act of concubitus) thrust against the sides of the pubes. (K.) ―
-b3- He beat or struck, with a staff, or stick, upon the posteriors, (K,) between the thigh and the hip. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
